contentText: Syllabus (GS3):  Pension (EPFO, NPS, UPS) and financial inclusion (Jan Dhan, MUDRA, MSME credit, gig workers). Insurance vs Pension:  insurance pays on death/damage; pension pays monthly income after retirement (and to spouse after). 1. EPFO EPFO (1951-52, Labour Ministry):  run by a tripartite Central Board of Trustees (Govt 15 + employers 10 + employees 10). Doesn't distinguish casual/temporary vs permanent workers; subscriber has a UAN (portable across jobs). EPFO scheme What it gives EPF (1952) Provident fund: principal + interest (~8.25%) on retirement/death; partial early withdrawal allowed. EDLI (1976) Insurance: boss pays premium; family gets cover on worker's death. EPS (1995) Pension after age 58 (min Rs.1,000/month to spouse); NOT linked to share market. Reforms:  auto-settlement of advance claims raised to Rs.5 lakh (2025); withdrawal categories cut 13 -> 3; CPPS (centralized pension payment - any bank); EPFO 3.0 (CBS-like app, UPI withdrawal); RBI oversight added to improve returns (2025). Govt contribution schemes:  Atmanirbhar Bharat Rozgar Yojana (Govt paid EPF share, 2020);  ELI Scheme  (Budget-2024): Part A - first-time worker gets up to Rs.15k (PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana); Part B/C - support to employers per new job. 2. NPS, UPS & OPS NPS:  New Pension Scheme (2003, by Vajpayee) -> National Pension System (2009). Mandatory for govt employees joining on/after 1-Jan-2004; opened to all citizens (2009). Subscriber has a PRAN; money invested in G-Sec/bonds/shares (market-linked). Q - UPS - Unified Pension Scheme (2024)? Feature Detail Start 1-Apr-2025 (central govt; employee can choose NPS or UPS) Contribution Employee 10%, Govt 18.5% (vs 14% in NPS) Assured pension Rs.10,000/month (10 yr service); 50% of last 12-month avg salary (25 yr service) On death 60% family pension to spouse; rises with CPI-IW inflation OPS (Old Pension Scheme):  defined-benefit, fully govt-funded; some non-BJP states (Rajasthan) reverted (deemed unsustainable).  Somanathan Committee  reviewed NPS -> led to UPS. Other NPS:  NPS-Lite/Swavlamban (poor, Govt co-contributes); NPS-Vatsalya (minors, Budget-2024); MARS (minimum assured return); penny-drop verification mandatory (2023). Jeevan Pramaan (2014):  Aadhaar-based Digital Life Certificate for pensioners (also EPFO; facial recognition added 2022). 3. Pension for the Poor Q - Atal Pension Yojana vs PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan? Atal Pension Yojana (2015, DFS) PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (2019, Labour Min) Age 18-40; no income limit (but pension max Rs.5,000) Unorganized workers with income up to Rs.15k/month Pension Rs.1,000-5,000/month after 60 Assured Rs.3,000/month after 60; Govt co-contributes Spouse gets same pension after subscriber's death Spouse gets Rs.1,500 family pension 3 Maan-Dhan Yojanas:  Shram Yogi (workers), Laghu Vyapari (small traders, turnover <= Rs.1.5 cr), Kisan (small/marginal farmers). One person = one scheme. APY + PMJJBY + PMSBY  = Pradhan Mantri Jan Suraksha Schemes. NSoAP (1995, no premium, 100% Union core-of-core):  Indira Gandhi old-age/widow/disability pensions + National Family Benefit; for BPL people without capacity to invest. Defined Contribution  (pension depends on market - NPS) vs  Defined Benefit  (fixed pension - EPS, OPS, UPS, APY, NSoAP). PFRDA (2003, statutory 2013, HQ Delhi):  regulates NPS & all pension funds EXCEPT EPFO/coal/seamen (separate laws). ES25: India's pension assets (EPFO 17% + NPS 4.5% of GDP) far below OECD's ~80%; 80% of pensioners are on tiny Atal Pension. Overseas:  Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (mandatory for workers to ECR countries; MEA); India-US Totalisation pact under negotiation. 4. Financial Inclusion - Bank for Everyone Financial Inclusion  (banking/loans/investment/pension/insurance for all) + Social Security (aid to ill/aged/poor - DPSP Art 41/42) + Social Justice = human development. Timeline:  Lead Bank Scheme (1969, Service Area Approach); RRBs (1976); no-frills account (2005); Business Correspondent agents (2006); e-KYC (2013); Jan Dhan (2014); Small Finance & Payment Banks (2015). Rule:  banks must open 25% of branches in unbanked rural areas. Q - PM Jan Dhan Yojana (2014)? Account:  Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account, zero-balance, RuPay debit card. Overdraft:  up to Rs.10,000 (one per household, preferably woman). Insurance:  free Rs.2 lakh accident cover (premium by NPCI). JAM trinity:  Jan Dhan + Aadhaar + Mobile -> direct benefit transfer of subsidies. 5. Small Savings & Deposit Protection Schemes:  NSC, Kisan Vikas Patra, PPF, Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (limit raised to Rs.30 lakh), Sukanya Samriddhi (girl child 0-10, prevents child marriage), Mahila Samman Bachat Patra (2023, Rs.2 lakh, 7.5%). Interest  set quarterly by FinMin's Dept of Economic Affairs; money goes to National Small Savings Fund (NSSF). Chit funds  = collective investment (Concurrent List).  Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act 2019  bans schemes not registered with any regulator (penalty up to Rs.50 cr / 10 yr jail). 6. Credit & MSME Finance Credit guarantee:  if borrower defaults, guarantor covers the bank's loss (collateral-free lending). Key funds: CGTMSE (SIDBI+Govt, micro/small), NCGTC (MUDRA, education, ECLGS, Stand-Up). Budget-2025 raised MSME cover to Rs.10 cr, startups Rs.20 cr. MSME definition  (MSMED Act 2006, revised 2020/2025) by investment + turnover; all bank loans to MSMEs qualify as Priority Sector. ECLGS (Covid):  collateral-free extra loans (20% of outstanding) to non-NPA MSMEs; guarantee by NCGTC. Subordinate Debt for NPA MSMEs (CGTMSE). Fund of Funds (Rs.10k cr) for MSME equity. Budget-2024:  MSME loans via digital footprint (UPI data) instead of balance sheet; interest equalization for MSME exporters. Scheme Detail MUDRA (2015, 100% SIDBI subsidiary) Indirect refinance to banks/NBFCs for micro units. Shishu (<=Rs.50k), Kishor (<=Rs.5L), Tarun (<=Rs.20L); collateral-free (CGFMU guarantee). Stand-Up India (2016) Each bank branch lends Rs.10 lakh-Rs.1 cr to >=1 SC/ST and >=1 woman entrepreneur. Self-Help Group (SHG) NABARD's SHG-Bank Linkage (1992); joint liability; supported by RRBs & SCBs; formed under NRLM. PM-SVANidhi (2020, MoHUA) Street-vendor loans Rs.10k -> 20k -> 50k; interest subsidy; Budget-2025 Rs.30k credit card. PM Vishwakarma (2023, MSME Min) Loan + skill training for 18 traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, cobbler...). Kisan Credit Card (1998) Short-term crop credit; MISS interest subvention. Gig workers:  defined under the Code on Social Security 2020; a Social Security Fund proposed.  Micro-insurance  for the poor. RBI has 3 Ombudsman schemes for customer grievances. Portals: Jan Samarth, psbloansin59minutes, PM-SURAJ. Key Facts (Quick Revision) Fact Detail EPFO (1952) EPF + EDLI (1976) + EPS (1995); Labour Ministry; UAN. NPS 2004 (govt) / 2009 (all); started by Vajpayee; market-linked; PRAN. UPS (2024) Govt 18.5%; 50% salary pension (25 yr); starts 1-Apr-2025. Atal Pension 18-40 age; Rs.1,000-5,000/month; DFS 2015. PFRDA (2013) Regulates NPS & pension funds except EPFO. PMJDY (2014) Zero-balance account, Rs.10k OD, Rs.2 lakh accident cover; JAM trinity. MUDRA (2015) SIDBI subsidiary; Shishu/Kishor/Tarun (Rs.50k/Rs.5L/Rs.20L). Stand-Up India (2016) Rs.10 lakh-Rs.1 cr to SC/ST & women entrepreneurs. NSoAP (1995) Indira Gandhi pensions; 100% Union; no premium. Practice PYQs (attached PDF) UPSC/CAPF PYQs - full question, options and answer with reasoning - are in the attached PDF below.
